# arXiv.org
> Open-access e-print archive for research papers across physics, mathematics, computer science, quantitative biology, and related fields.

arXiv is a free repository for scholarly preprints and e-prints operated by Cornell University. It provides subject-based browsing, search, author submission workflows, APIs, and extensive help documentation for readers, authors, and integrators.

## Core Archive
- [arXiv Home](https://arxiv.org): Main entry point for browsing, searching, and accessing the arXiv e-print archive.
- [Search](https://arxiv.org/search): Search papers, authors, abstracts, and metadata across all arXiv subject areas.
- [Advanced Search](https://arxiv.org/search/advanced): Fielded search interface for precise queries across titles, authors, abstracts, and categories.
- [Current Listings](https://arxiv.org/list): Browse current subject listings and recent submissions by archive and category.
- [Catchup](https://arxiv.org/catchup): View catch-up listings of recent submissions across arXiv categories.
- [Archive Statistics](https://arxiv.org/stats/monthly_submissions): Monthly submission statistics and archive growth data by subject area.

## Subject Areas
- [Physics](https://arxiv.org/archive/physics): Browse physics archives and category listings on arXiv.
- [Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/archive/math): Browse mathematics archives and category listings on arXiv.
- [Computer Science](https://arxiv.org/archive/cs): Browse computer science archives and category listings on arXiv.
- [Quantitative Biology](https://arxiv.org/archive/q-bio): Browse quantitative biology archives and category listings on arXiv.
- [Quantitative Finance](https://arxiv.org/archive/q-fin): Browse quantitative finance archives and category listings on arXiv.
- [Statistics](https://arxiv.org/archive/stat): Browse statistics archives and category listings on arXiv.
- [Electrical Engineering and Systems Science](https://arxiv.org/archive/eess): Browse electrical engineering and systems science categories.
- [Economics](https://arxiv.org/archive/econ): Browse economics archives and category listings on arXiv.

## Popular Category Listings
- [Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph/recent): Recent submissions in astrophysics and its subcategories.
- [High Energy Physics - Theory](https://arxiv.org/list/hep-th/recent): Recent submissions in theoretical high energy physics.
- [Condensed Matter](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat/recent): Recent submissions in condensed matter physics.
- [Mathematical Physics](https://arxiv.org/list/math-ph/recent): Recent submissions in mathematical physics.
- [Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.LG/recent): Recent submissions in machine learning.
- [Computation and Language](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.CL/recent): Recent submissions in natural language processing and computation with language.
- [Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.CV/recent): Recent submissions in computer vision and pattern recognition.
- [Statistics Theory](https://arxiv.org/list/stat.TH/recent): Recent submissions in theoretical statistics.

## Authoring and Submission
- [Submit](https://arxiv.org/submit): Start a new submission or manage an in-progress arXiv submission.
- [Login](https://arxiv.org/login): Sign in to submit papers, manage accounts, and access author tools.
- [Submission Help](https://info.arxiv.org/help/submit): Help for preparing and submitting papers to arXiv.
- [Submission Process](https://info.arxiv.org/help/submit/submit.html): Step-by-step overview of the arXiv submission workflow.
- [Update Submission](https://info.arxiv.org/help/submit/replace.html): Guidance for replacing or updating an existing arXiv submission.
- [Withdrawals](https://info.arxiv.org/help/withdraw): Policies and instructions for withdrawing submissions.
- [Endorsement](https://info.arxiv.org/help/endorsement): Explanation of arXiv's endorsement system for new submitters.
- [Source Format Requirements](https://info.arxiv.org/help/submit_tex.html): Technical requirements for TeX and source files used in submissions.

## Help and User Support
- [Help Pages](https://info.arxiv.org/help): Central help hub for arXiv users, authors, and developers.
- [FAQ](https://info.arxiv.org/help/faq): Frequently asked questions about arXiv services and policies.
- [Search Help](https://info.arxiv.org/help/search): Guidance for using arXiv search and query features.
- [Account Help](https://info.arxiv.org/help/account): Help for account creation, login, and profile management.
- [Contact](https://info.arxiv.org/help/contact.html): Contact options for support, moderation, and general inquiries.
- [Subscribe](https://info.arxiv.org/help/subscribe): Subscription options for arXiv announcements and updates.
- [Web Accessibility Assistance](https://info.arxiv.org/help/web_accessibility.html): Accessibility support information for using arXiv services.

## API and Integrations
- [API Overview](https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/index.html): Overview of arXiv APIs and machine-accessible services.
- [API User Manual](https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/user-manual.html): Documentation for querying the arXiv API and interpreting responses.
- [OAI-PMH Interface](https://info.arxiv.org/help/oa/index.html): Metadata harvesting documentation for the OAI-PMH interface.
- [Bulk Data Access](https://info.arxiv.org/help/bulk_data_s3.html): Information on accessing arXiv bulk data through cloud-hosted distribution.
- [RSS Feeds](https://info.arxiv.org/help/rss.html): Documentation for category-based RSS feeds of new submissions.
- [arXiv Identifier Format](https://info.arxiv.org/help/arxiv_identifier.html): Explanation of arXiv identifier formats and versioned paper IDs.

## Policies and Moderation
- [Policies](https://info.arxiv.org/help/policies/index.html): Index of arXiv policies governing submissions, use, and operations.
- [Moderation](https://info.arxiv.org/help/moderation): Overview of moderation practices and subject classification review.
- [Content Policy](https://info.arxiv.org/help/policies/content_policy.html): Policy describing what content is appropriate for arXiv.
- [Submission Terms of Use](https://info.arxiv.org/help/policies/terms_of_use.html): Terms governing submission and use of arXiv services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://info.arxiv.org/help/policies/privacy_policy.html): Privacy practices for arXiv users and visitors.
- [License Information](https://info.arxiv.org/help/license/index.html): Copyright and licensing options for arXiv submissions.
- [Withdrawal Policy](https://info.arxiv.org/help/withdraw): Policy and process for withdrawing papers from arXiv.

## About arXiv
- [About](https://info.arxiv.org/about): Overview of arXiv's mission, history, governance, and operations.
- [Mission](https://info.arxiv.org/about/mission): arXiv's mission and role in open scholarly communication.
- [Governance](https://info.arxiv.org/about/governance): Governance structure, advisory boards, and institutional oversight.
- [Membership](https://info.arxiv.org/about/arxiv_membership): Information about arXiv's membership and support model.
- [Cornell University Library](https://info.arxiv.org/about/cornell): Cornell's role in operating and supporting arXiv.
- [Accessibility at arXiv](https://info.arxiv.org/about/accessibility): Accessibility commitments and ongoing improvements for arXiv services.

## Service Status and Operations
- [Operational Status](https://status.arxiv.org): Live status page for arXiv systems and service incidents.
- [System Status Help](https://info.arxiv.org/help): Support resources related to service availability and platform use.
- [Copyright](https://info.arxiv.org/help/license/index.html): Copyright and reuse information for submissions and site content.
- [Contact Support](https://info.arxiv.org/help/contact.html): Official support channels for operational and user issues.
